tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: The stage: page background behind everything. Dark is the default home.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the tab bar, inputs. One step up from surface-000.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Raised and hover fills: secondary buttons, selected rows, poster placeholders, neutral badges.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines that only separate (card outlines, dividers). Decorative, not for controls.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, stepper, secondary buttons), the ticket perforation, the total rule. 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface-000, surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (venue, dates, hints, fees) on surface-000, surface-100 and surface-200. 4.5:1 on all three.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Marigold, the backstage-pass colour. Primary buttons, the date stamp, the active tab, checked boxes. Always a fill: put on-brand text on it.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for brand buttons.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand and brand-hover, in both themes (12:1 / 10:1).

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Brand as text (links, inline emphasis) on surface-000 and surface-100. Darkened on paper to hold 4.5:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Encore coral. Favourites, count badges, rare highlight moments. Never for errors.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent fills (tab badges).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Available / confirmed / discounts. Cyan rather than green so it never relies on red-green hue alone. Text on surface-100 and success-soft.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind success badges and notices.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Few left, hold expiring, price changed. Text on surface-100 and warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind warning badges and notices.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Sold out, payment failed, field errors, destructive actions. Text on surface-100, surface-200 and danger-soft. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind danger badges and notices.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px focus outline, offset 2px so it sits on the surface, not the control. 9:1 or more on every surface in both themes.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headlines and the wordmark on marketing surfaces. Upper case, two lines at most.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Event title on the event page; section heroes.

styles.name: display-numeral
styles.usage: The day numeral in the date stamp. Numerals only.

styles.name: heading-s
styles.usage: Card titles (EventCard), ticket-type names, section heads.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Doors open at 19:30. Bring the QR code on your phone.

styles.name: body-s
styles.sample: Includes a €2.50 booking fee per ticket.
styles.usage: Hints, fees, fine print, field labels (at 600).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Badges, categories, overlines. Always upper case.

styles.name: mono-m
styles.usage: Prices, totals, quantities. Tabular figures so columns align.

styles.name: mono-s
styles.usage: Order numbers, seat codes, gate codes, timers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text in badges; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls; between meta lines.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Field padding; gaps between related controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between cards; section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, notices, the date stamp.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and sheets (EventCard, order summary).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Steppers, icon buttons, step dots, the active-tab pill.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and the sticky checkout bar only. Cards use line, not shadow.
